articles.title_en: Dividend Taxation and Firm Performance with Heterogeneous Payout Responses
articles.title_cn: 股息税与企业绩效：异质性派息反应
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the performance of firms that were differentially affected by an unexpected tax on dividends before the global financial crisis. We use exogenous policy variation for firms with different legal statuses and financial year-end dates to separately identify the policy announcement and implementation effects. We provide causal evidence for a sharp drop in dividends but zero change in equipment purchases. Treated firms accumulate investment goods that are likely to be owner-manager’s personal assets instead of productive capital. At a time of severe liquidity shortage, some of the funds kept in the firm are used to pay back short-term debt. (JEL G01, G31, G32, G35, H25, K34)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在全球金融危机前受到意外股息税影响不同的企业的绩效。我们利用不同法律地位和财政年度结束日期的企业的外生政策变化，分别识别政策公告和实施效应。我们提供了因果证据，表明股息急剧下降但设备购买没有变化。受处理的企业积累的投资品可能是所有者-管理者的个人资产，而非生产性资本。在严重流动性短缺时期，留在企业中的部分资金被用于偿还短期债务。(JEL G01, G31, G32, G35, H25, K34)

articles.title_en: Buy Baits and Consumer Sophistication: Field Evidence from Instant Rebates
articles.title_cn: 购买诱饵与消费者精明度：即时回扣的现场证据
articles.abstract_en: Are consumers in the marketplace aware of their cognitive limitations? I answer this question in the context of a ubiquitous form of price discrimination: instant rebates that require active redemption. In a large-scale field experiment with a major online retailer, I find that consumers correctly increase demand when the firm offers a redemption reminder, but they fail to reduce demand when the firm increases the hassle required to redeem. Structural estimates reveal that, while consumers are sophisticated about the probability of forgetting to redeem the rebate, they vastly underestimate the hassle of redeeming it by €20 per consumer. (JEL C93, D12, D83, D91, L81, M31)
articles.abstract_cn: 市场中的消费者是否意识到自己的认知局限？我在一种普遍存在的价格歧视形式——需要主动兑换的即时回扣——的背景下回答了这个问题。在一项与一家大型在线零售商合作的大规模现场实验中，我发现当企业提供兑换提醒时，消费者正确增加了需求，但当企业增加兑换所需的麻烦时，他们未能减少需求。结构估计显示，虽然消费者对忘记兑换回扣的概率是精明的，但他们大大低估了兑换回扣的麻烦，每位消费者低估了€20。 (JEL C93, D12, D83, D91, L81, M31)

articles.title_en: Increasing Organ Donor Registration as a Means to Increase Transplantation: An Experiment with Actual Organ Donor Registrations
articles.title_cn: 增加器官捐献者登记作为提高移植率的手段：一项基于实际器官捐献者登记的实验
articles.abstract_en: The United States has a severe shortage of organs for transplant. Recently—inspired by research based on hypothetical choices— jurisdictions have tried to increase organ donor registrations by changing how the registration question is asked. We evaluate these changes with a novel “field-in-the-lab” experiment, in which subjects change their real organ donor status, and with new donor registration data collected from US states. A “yes/no” frame is not more effective than an “ opt-in” frame, contradicting conclusions based on hypothetical choices, but other question wording can matter, and asking individuals to reconsider their donor status increases registrations. (JEL C91, D12, D91, I11, I18)
articles.abstract_cn: 美国面临严重的移植器官短缺问题。近期，受基于假设选择的研究启发，一些司法管辖区尝试通过改变登记问题的提问方式来增加器官捐献者登记。我们通过一种新颖的“实验室实地”实验评估了这些变化，在该实验中，受试者改变其真实的器官捐献者状态，并使用了从美国各州收集的新捐献者登记数据。“是/否”框架并不比“选择加入”框架更有效，这与基于假设选择得出的结论相矛盾，但其他问题措辞可能产生影响，且要求个体重新考虑其捐献者状态会增加登记数量。（JEL C91, D12, D91, I11, I18）

articles.title_en: Public and Private Provision of Information in Market-Based Public Programs: Evidence from Advertising in Health Insurance Marketplaces
articles.title_cn: 市场型公共项目中信息的公共与私人提供：来自健康保险市场广告的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies government and private advertising in market-based public programs. In a model of advertising, we first examine when government advertising increases welfare. Then, we estimate the effects of advertising on consumer demand and assess their welfare effects in the Affordable Care Act health insurance marketplaces. We find government advertising increases overall enrollment and enhances welfare. By contrast, the market expansion effect of private advertising is modest at most. Although private advertising increases demand for insurers in certain specifications, it is not a very efficient tool to induce consumers to select insurers with better plans due to rent-seeking competition. (JEL G22, G52, H51, I13, M37)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了市场型公共项目中的政府与私人广告。在广告模型中，我们首先考察政府广告何时能提高福利。然后，我们估计广告对消费者需求的影响，并评估其在《平价医疗法案》健康保险市场中的福利效应。我们发现政府广告增加了总体参保率并提升了福利。相比之下，私人广告的市场扩张效应最多是适度的。尽管在某些设定下私人广告增加了对保险公司的需求，但由于寻租竞争，它并不是引导消费者选择更优计划保险公司的有效工具。(JEL G22, G52, H51, I13, M37)

articles.title_en: Welfare Analysis of Changing Notches: Evidence from Bolsa Família
articles.title_cn: 改变断点处的福利分析：来自家庭补助金的证据
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework to bound the welfare impacts of arbitrarily large reforms to notches using two sufficient statistics: the change in the number of households located below the new notch and the change in the number of households located below the old notch. Our bounds hold in a wide class of models, highlighting a new way to use reduced-form bunching evidence for welfare analysis without making strong assumptions on the economic environment. We estimate these two statistics using a difference-in-difference strategy for a reform to the antipoverty program Bolsa Família, finding that the reform’s MVPF is between 0.90–1.12. (JEL D12, D91, H83, I32, I38, O12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架，利用两个充分统计量来界定任意大规模断点改革的福利影响：位于新断点以下的家庭数量变化和位于旧断点以下的家庭数量变化。我们的界限在广泛的模型类别中成立，突显了一种利用简化形式的聚集证据进行福利分析的新方法，而无需对经济环境做出强假设。我们使用双重差分策略估计了针对反贫困项目家庭补助金改革的这两个统计量，发现该改革的边际价值公共资金（MVPF）介于0.90-1.12之间。（JEL D12, D91, H83, I32, I38, O12）

articles.title_en: A Machine Learning Approach to Analyze and Support Anticorruption Policy
articles.title_cn: 一种支持反腐败政策分析与制定的机器学习方法
articles.abstract_en: Can machine learning support better governance? This study uses a tree-based, gradient-boosted classifier to predict corruption in Brazilian municipalities using budget data as predictors. The trained model offers a predictive measure of corruption, which we validate through replication and extension of previous corruption studies. Our policy simulations show that machine learning can significantly enhance corruption detection: Compared to random audits, a machine-guided targeted policy could detect almost twice as many corrupt municipalities for the same audit rate. (JEL C45, D73, H70, H83, K42, O17)
articles.abstract_cn: 机器学习能否支持更好的治理？本研究使用基于树的梯度提升分类器，以预算数据作为预测变量，预测巴西各城市的腐败情况。训练后的模型提供了腐败的预测度量，我们通过复制和扩展以往的腐败研究来验证该模型。我们的政策模拟表明，机器学习能显著增强腐败检测：与随机审计相比，在相同的审计率下，机器引导的定向政策可以检测出几乎两倍多的腐败城市。（JEL C45, D73, H70, H83, K42, O17）

articles.title_en: Do Consumers Distinguish Fixed Cost from Variable Cost? “Schmeduling” in Two-Part Tariffs in Energy
articles.title_cn: 消费者能否区分固定成本与可变成本？能源两部定价中的“施梅杜林”现象
articles.abstract_en: A central assumption in economics is that consumers properly distinguish fixed cost from variable cost. This assumption is fundamental to various economic theories, including optimal taxation, redistribution, and price discrimination. Using a quasi-experiment in heating price reform in China, we find empirical evidence that is inconsistent with this conventional assumption and more consistent with the “schmeduling” model in Liebman and Zeckhauser (2004). As we demonstrate its policy implications for two-part energy tariffs, this schmeduling behavior makes fixed costs directly relevant to the perceived relative prices of goods, and therefore alters the welfare implications of price, tax, and subsidy designs. (JEL D12, D91, H24, L94, O12, P28, P36)
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学中的一个核心假设是，消费者能够正确区分固定成本与可变成本。这一假设是多种经济理论的基础，包括最优税收、再分配和价格歧视。利用中国供暖价格改革中的一项准实验，我们发现了与该传统假设不符、而更符合Liebman和Zeckhauser（2004）提出的“施梅杜林”模型的实证证据。正如我们对其在能源两部定价中的政策含义所展示的，这种施梅杜林行为使得固定成本直接与商品感知相对价格相关，从而改变了价格、税收和补贴设计的福利含义。（JEL D12, D91, H24, L94, O12, P28, P36）

articles.title_en: Free Trade and the Formation of Environmental Policy: Evidence from US Legislative Votes
articles.title_cn: 自由贸易与环境政策的形成：来自美国立法投票的证据
articles.abstract_en: We test the hypothesis that governments alter environmental policy in response to trade by studying NAFTA’s effects on the formation of environmental policy in the US House of Representatives between 1990 and 2000. We find that reductions in US tariffs decreased political support for environmental legislation. This decrease appears to be due to (i) a reduction in support by incumbent Republican legislators in response to trade-induced changes in the policy preferences of their constituents and (ii) changes in partisan representation in affected districts due to decreased electoral support for pro-NAFTA Democrats following the agreement. (JEL D72, F13, F15, F18, Q56, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过研究北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）对1990年至2000年间美国众议院环境政策形成的影响，检验了政府因贸易而改变环境政策的假设。我们发现，美国关税的降低减少了对环境立法的政治支持。这种减少似乎归因于：（i）在任共和党议员因贸易引起的其选区政策偏好变化而减少支持，以及（ii）协议签署后，受影响的选区中，由于支持北美自由贸易协定的民主党人选举支持率下降，导致党派代表性的变化。（JEL D72, F13, F15, F18, Q56, Q58）

articles.title_en: Show Me the Money! A Field Experiment on Electric Vehicle Charge Timing
articles.title_cn: 给我看钱！电动汽车充电时机的实地实验
articles.abstract_en: We use a field experiment to measure the effectiveness of financial incentives to shift the timing of electric vehicle (EV) charging. EV owners respond strongly to financial incentives, reducing charging during peak hours by 49 percent by shifting to off-peak hours. In contrast, a prosocial information treatment has no discernible effect. When financial incentives are removed, charge timing reverts to pre-intervention behavior, reinforcing that “money matters.” Our findings highlight the substantial flexibility of EV charging compared to other forms of electricity demand. Such flexibility has the potential to greatly reduce future electric system costs arising from a rapidly decarbonizing transportation sector. (JEL C93, D12, D91, L92, L94, Q48)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项实地实验来衡量经济激励在改变电动汽车（EV）充电时机方面的有效性。电动汽车车主对经济激励反应强烈，通过将充电时间转移到非高峰时段，高峰时段的充电量减少了49%。相比之下，一种亲社会信息干预没有明显效果。当经济激励被取消后，充电时机恢复到干预前的行为，这强化了“金钱重要”的观点。我们的研究结果突显了电动汽车充电相对于其他形式的电力需求具有显著的灵活性。这种灵活性有潜力大幅降低因交通部门快速脱碳而产生的未来电力系统成本。（JEL C93, D12, D91, L92, L94, Q48）

articles.title_en: Who Watches the Watchmen? Local News and Police Behavior in the United States
articles.title_cn: 谁在监督监督者？美国地方新闻与警察行为
articles.abstract_en: Do US municipal police departments respond to news coverage of local crime? We address this question exploiting an exogenous shock to local crime reporting induced by acquisitions of local TV stations by a large broadcast group, Sinclair. Using a unique dataset of 8.5 million news stories and a triple-differences design, we document that Sinclair ownership decreases news coverage of local crime. This matters for policing: Municipalities that experience the change in news coverage have lower violent crime clearance rates relative to municipalities that do not. The result is consistent with a decrease of crime salience in the public opinion. (JEL D83, G34, H76, K42, L13, L82)
articles.abstract_cn: 美国市政警察部门是否会对地方犯罪的新闻报道作出回应？我们通过利用大型广播集团辛克莱收购地方电视台所引发的地方犯罪报道的外生冲击来探讨这一问题。利用包含8.5万条新闻故事的独特数据集和三重差分设计，我们记录了辛克莱所有权减少了地方犯罪的新闻报道。这对警务工作具有重要意义：经历新闻报道变化的市政当局，其暴力犯罪破案率相对于未经历变化的市政当局更低。这一结果与公众舆论中犯罪显著性的下降相一致。（JEL D83, G34, H76, K42, L13, L82）

articles.title_en: The Effects of a Multifaceted Poverty Alleviation Program on Rural Income and Household Behavior in China
articles.title_cn: 多维度扶贫项目对中国农村收入与家庭行为的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the effects of a government-led, large-scale, multifaceted poverty alleviation program on rural income in China. We find that the program has a positive impact on national key poor counties, with a 10.9 percent increase in rural income. This effect mainly arises via industrial support, agricultural development, and public service improvement. Poverty alleviation strategies consistent with local comparative advantages yield more significant effects. Household-level analyses suggest the program changes households’ income and expenditure, and the effects are particularly substantial for the poorest households. The study provides novel insights and policy implications for China’s recent experience with poverty alleviation. (JEL H53, I32, I38, O12, O18, P25, P36)
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了政府主导的大规模多维度扶贫项目对中国农村收入的影响。我们发现该项目对国家级贫困县有积极影响，农村收入增加了10.9%。这一效应主要通过产业支持、农业发展和公共服务改善实现。与当地比较优势相一致的扶贫策略产生了更显著的效果。家庭层面的分析表明，该项目改变了家庭的收入和支出，且对最贫困家庭的影响尤为显著。本研究为中国近期的扶贫经验提供了新颖的见解和政策启示。(JEL H53, I32, I38, O12, O18, P25, P36)

articles.title_en: Corporate Minimum Tax and the Elasticity of Taxable Income: Evidence from Administrative Tax Records
articles.title_cn: 公司最低税与应税所得弹性：来自行政税务记录的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine business responses to a minimum tax (MT) that prescribed fixed floors on corporate tax liability while permitting MT credit carryforwards. Using 2010–2020 tax-return data on all Slovak corporations, we find that many companies immediately relocated from reporting zero taxable income toward bunching at the new floors. We infer the elasticity of taxable income (ETI) to be between 0.33 and 2.28 across value-added tax (VAT) and turnover categories, and quantify the marginal efficiency burden (MEB) of the corporation tax. Given limited extensive-margin responses, our evidence suggests the MT reduced the overall efficiency burden while raising additional tax revenue. (JEL D22, E62, H25, H32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了企业对最低税（MT）的反应，该税种规定了公司税负的固定下限，同时允许最低税抵免结转。利用2010-2020年所有斯洛伐克公司的纳税申报数据，我们发现许多公司立即从报告零应税所得转向在新下限处聚集。我们推断，在增值税（VAT）和营业额类别中，应税所得弹性（ETI）介于0.33和2.28之间，并量化了公司税的边际效率负担（MEB）。鉴于有限的广延边际反应，我们的证据表明，最低税在增加额外税收收入的同时，降低了整体效率负担。（JEL D22, E62, H25, H32）

articles.title_en: Informing Mothers about the Benefits of Conversing with Infants: Experimental Evidence from Ghana
articles.title_cn: 告知母亲与婴儿交谈的益处：来自加纳的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate a low-cost intervention designed to boost parents’ verbal engagement with infants, which tends to be limited in developing countries. In our randomized experiment, recent or expectant mothers watched a three-minute informational video and received a themed calendar. Six months later, treated mothers reported stronger belief in the benefits of verbal engagement, more frequent parent-infant conversation, and more advanced infant language skills. Treatment effects on objective measures of parent-child conversation frequency and infant skills were positive but insignificant. We find larger immediate treatment effects on objective parent-child conversation, suggesting potentially larger long-term effects had the behavior change stuck more. (JEL D83, D91, I26, J13, J16, O12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了一项旨在提升父母与婴儿语言互动参与度的低成本干预措施，这种互动在发展中国家往往有限。在我们的随机实验中，近期或即将成为母亲的女性观看了一段三分钟的信息视频，并收到了一份主题日历。六个月后，接受干预的母亲报告称，她们对语言互动益处的信念更强，亲子对话更频繁，婴儿语言技能也更先进。干预对亲子对话频率和婴儿技能的客观测量结果为正，但不显著。我们发现干预对客观亲子对话的即时效应更大，这表明如果行为改变能更持久，长期效应可能会更大。(JEL D83, D91, I26, J13, J16, O12)

articles.title_cn: 薪酬透明度与性别平等
articles.abstract_en: Since 2018, UK firms with at least 250 employees have been mandated to publicly disclose gender equality indicators. Exploiting variations in this mandate across firm size and time, we show that pay transparency closes 19 percent of the gender pay gap by reducing men’s pay growth. By combining different sources of data, we also provide suggestive evidence that the public availability of the equality indicators enhances public scrutiny. In turn, employers more exposed to public scrutiny seem to reduce their gender pay gap the most. (JEL D22, J16, J24, J31, L25)
articles.abstract_cn: 自2018年起，英国至少有250名员工的企业被强制要求公开披露性别平等指标。利用这一规定在企业规模和时间上的差异，我们表明薪酬透明度通过降低男性薪酬增长，缩小了19%的性别薪酬差距。通过结合不同来源的数据，我们还提供了暗示性证据，表明平等指标的公开可获得性增强了公众监督。相应地，更受公众监督的雇主似乎最大程度地缩小了其性别薪酬差距。(JEL D22, J16, J24, J31, L25)

articles.title_en: Communicating Program Eligibility: A Supplemental Security Income (SSI) Field Experiment
articles.title_cn: 传达项目资格：一项补充保障收入（SSI）实地实验
articles.abstract_en: We conducted a direct mail field experiment with 4,016,461 individuals to test several key hypotheses about why take-up of Supplemental Security Income among individuals age 65 and above is so low. Communicating likely eligibility in a basic letter generated substantial increases in take-up in relative terms. Adding behaviorally informed statements increased the effectiveness of these communications. Yet, the application rate in our study sample during the full 24-month follow-up period remained no greater than 7 percent. Our results reveal a modest trade-off between increasing applications and the conditional likelihood of award, as well as the award amount. (JEL C93, D12, D83, H55, I38, J14)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们对4,016,461名个体进行了一项直邮实地实验，以检验关于65岁及以上个体补充保障收入领取率为何如此之低的几个关键假设。在基本信函中传达可能的资格条件，相对而言显著提高了领取率。加入行为知情陈述增强了这些沟通的有效性。然而，在我们研究样本中，整个24个月随访期间的申请率仍不超过7%%。我们的结果揭示了增加申请与获奖条件概率及获奖金额之间存在适度权衡。（JEL C93, D12, D83, H55, I38, J14）

articles.title_en: Physician Group Influences on Treatment Intensity and Health: Evidence from Physician Switchers
articles.title_cn: 医生群体对治疗强度与健康的影响：来自医生转组证据
articles.abstract_en: Treatment intensity varies remarkably across physicians, and physicians are increasingly working in groups. This paper tests whether group affiliation impacts physicians’ treatment intensity and patient health. Using Medicare inpatient claims data, we focus on internists who switch groups within the same hospital. Event studies show that internists who join more-intensive groups immediately increase their own intensity, with an elasticity of 0.27. This change is reflected in higher Medicare spending due to higher-priced services. We do not detect a change in health outcomes, suggesting that treatment intensity induced by group affiliation may not be productive.(JEL H51, I11, I13, I18, J44)
articles.abstract_cn: 治疗强度在不同医生间差异显著，且医生越来越多地在群体中工作。本文检验群体归属是否影响医生的治疗强度及患者健康。利用医疗保险住院索赔数据，我们聚焦于在同一医院内转换群体的内科医生。事件研究显示，加入更密集群体的内科医生立即提高自身治疗强度，弹性为0.27。这一变化反映在因更高价格服务导致的医疗保险支出增加上。我们未检测到健康结果的变化，表明由群体归属引起的治疗强度可能不具有生产性。(JEL H51, I11, I13, I18, J44)
